Toyota Corolla

2020–2023 · 1.6 petrol · automatic · Economy class

  • 5 seats, 2 suitcases
  • Fuel ~6.0 l / 100 km
  • Cruise control

Few cars are as easy to hand over to someone who has never driven in Georgia before. The Corolla is predictable, light on the steering, short enough for the narrow streets of the old town, and it carries the reliability record that made the model famous — a real consideration when your day starts in a village at seven in the morning.

The 1.6 petrol automatic uses about 6.0 l/100 km, and cruise control makes the long straight stretches of the Tbilisi–Batumi highway far less tiring. Five seats and two suitcases suit a couple or a small family.

  • Good for: the Kakheti wine routes, Borjomi, Kutaisi, the Black Sea coast
  • Not suitable: any unpaved road — clearance is only 135 mm

Damage caused on the gravel tracks to Ushguli or Omalo is excluded from cover on non-4x4 cars, so those routes need a vehicle from the off-road category. The rate is 88 ₾ a day and falls for longer bookings — see Prices.
